description: This file defines an event listener class EmployeeSalaryListener for the OrangeHRM system. It hooks into lifecycle events of the EmployeeSalary entity to handle encryption and decryption of the 'amount' field during persistence, update, and loading operations.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryListener
classes.description: An event listener class that handles encryption and decryption of EmployeeSalary entity's amount during lifecycle events.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Encrypts the salary amount before persisting if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Encrypts the salary amount before update if encryption is enabled and the amount field has changed.

methods.name: postUpdate
methods.description: Decrypts the salary amount after an update if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Decrypts the salary amount after entity is loaded if encryption is enabled.
